notes: DiscoFlate v3.36.0 (consolidation, part 4) — two action types collapse further. 'message' now has a Style dropdown (plain / embed) AND can carry the optional gated button, absorbing the old 'embed' action. 'award_prize' + 'award_amount' become one 'award' action with a dropdown: bonus command / volume seconds / volume %. Everything auto-migrates.
